title: 体验一下朝阳新款外胎 眼镜蛇H486
notes: Owner post (2023-12-01): two H-486 Cobra tires bought for a new frame, in retail boxes labelled 700x23C (23-622), H-486 and COBRA 眼镜蛇, with a box panel showing a five-star puncture rating and 120 TPI; the owner paid under CNY 200 for the pair and says the hand feel resembles a Continental 'GR sports' tire.
